critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' array to implement variable spacing: set the default interval to 150mm, but insert a 400mm gap at the front and rear fuselage sections corresponding to the door locations. Additionally, duplicate the existing window primitive row along the upper deck curve, offsetting it vertically by 300mm from the main deck line to create the two-tier window configuration.
